statement: A strict retraction exists in the same Hot class under the full hypotheses of CATHOT E.6.
depends_on: Thomason model factorization and lifting axioms
notes: Weaker Hot equality; this proof alone does not give a finite categorical homotopy.

statement: The Cat_hot strict-retraction assertion holds for local fibrant targets and for actual groupoid targets.
depends_on: D.1; definition of locality; explicit conjugation
notes: The actual groupoid argument applies to any full object-injective inclusion.

statement: Every prescribed fence homotopy extends along a full sieve into a target with a terminal object after one padding edge.
depends_on: Explicit extension by terminal object
notes: No fibrancy assumption is needed.

statement: Every prescribed fence homotopy extends along a pseudo-Dwyer inclusion into a target with an initial object after one padding edge; if its retracting cosieve is the whole target, no target condition is needed.
depends_on: D_Cisinski1999 Proposition 2; explicit pseudo-Dwyer data
notes: All mixed composition and naturality equations are checked.

statement: The non-cofibrant square corner has no exact extension to an initial three-object fork but admits a two-edge padded extension to that fibrant target.
depends_on: D.4; D_Thomason1980 Proposition 4.2; code/d_finite_checks.py
notes: Non-cofibrancy of the unpadded product corner does not refute the requested padded property.

statement: Thomason fibrancy of F implies injectivity of pi_0 Fun(X,F) to [BX,BF] for every X.
depends_on: D_Raptis2010 Theorem 2.6; explicit six-object free category; code/d_finite_checks.py
notes: Counterexample uses a finite X with 22 arrows and a specified infinite fibrant poset replacement of the six-point sphere; every functor into a poset factors through its posetal reflection.

statement: A backward natural transformation on the source of any full sieve extends strictly in one step.
depends_on: Explicit mixed-arrow composition formula
notes: All components outside the sieve can be identities.

statement: The universal strict-retraction assertion is equivalent to the forward endpoint-extension assertion.
depends_on: D.7; explicit fibrant collage and pushout construction
notes: This is an exact equivalence between two assertions; it asserts neither universal property without proof.

statement: Fixed-endpoint P4 paths in a Thomason-fibrant target represent its fundamental path classes, with a uniform eight-step relative categorical comparison.
depends_on: Kan edge calculus; explicit 25-object subdivided-triangle table; code/d_prism_probe.py
notes: Code verifies the lifted table inside the actual poset, so no categorical/posetal quotient identification is assumed.

statement: Full prescribed fence extension holds for any family of P4 cells attached in one stage, with length at most 9L.
notes: Settles the prompt's single attachment to a fibrant circle or sphere poset model, and arbitrary infinite coproducts of such attachments.

statement: Relative n-simplex comparisons in a fibrant target have a 4(n+1)-step fixed-boundary categorical homotopy.
depends_on: Relative simplicial cylinder; CpathsLurieHTT Proposition A.2.2.1; explicit flag sweep; code/d_higher_prism_checks.py
notes: Cylinder corrected after independent audit: glue along W=pi^{-1}(boundary), including the common end facet. Finite certificates cover dimensions 0 through 4.

statement: Full prescribed fence extension holds for finite composites of bounded-dimensional cell attachment stages and their arrow retracts.
depends_on: D.7; D.11; Kan mapping-space restriction fibration
notes: At one stage with dimension bound N, length at most (4N+5)L; finite stages multiply these bounds. Independently audited by the C agent.

statement: A Thomason cofibration finitely presented under its source has full prescribed fence extension; in particular every cofibration between finite categories does.
depends_on: D.12; small-object factorization; finite dependency closure
notes: Any counterexample to the full assertions must avoid these finite-presentation cases.

statement: The Cat_hot strict-retraction assertion for every U-small Thomason-fibrant A and every Thomason cofibration A to B.
notes: Resolved in checkpoint 03 by the explicit countable fibrant-collage counterexample D.19. This row preserves the earlier checkpoint identifier; it is no longer open.

statement: Full prescribed finite-fence homotopy extension for arbitrary Thomason cofibrations and fibrant targets.
notes: Resolved in checkpoint 03 by the isolated-identity fibrant poset and prescribed endpoint arrow in D.18. All finite-presentation positive cases remain valid.

statement: Uniform prescribed extension holds for filtered targets, targets with all pushouts, and targets with all pullbacks.
depends_on: D.7; explicit finite cocones, pushouts, and limits in slices
notes: Exact original fence suffices in the first two cases. All-pullback targets require at most 2L edges for every Thomason cofibration, including unrestricted cell complexes.

statement: Two edges do not suffice for every prescribed forward one-cell homotopy into a fibrant weakly contractible poset.
depends_on: D.10; D_Cisinski1999 Proposition 1; explicit horn completion; code/d_two_step_obstruction.py
notes: The seven-object finite core is exhaustively verified; the target is its explicitly specified omega-stage free horn completion. Independent audit passed.

statement: Every arbitrary horn-map pushout preserves finite principal ideals and absence of downbeat points; it preserves common-upper-bound existence between old objects.
depends_on: Explicit flag and Dwyer pushout formula; D_Thomason1980 Section 4; D_Cisinski1999
notes: The proof explicitly treats noninjective attaching maps and simultaneous coproducts. A new flag has old ideal either empty or the principal ideal of its maximal horn subflag image.

statement: The specified countable free Thomason fibrant completion of a point is bifibrant and weakly contractible, and its identity functor is isolated under natural transformations.
depends_on: D.16; explicit all-horns-every-pass construction; code/d_rigid_fibrant_checks.py
notes: Every horn map is freshly reattached even when already fillable. Fresh endpoint-0 one-horns give branching against every strict pair. Minimal-moved-object and branching arguments exclude all downward and upward endomorphisms of the identity. Independently audited.

statement: Full prescribed finite-fence extension holds for every Thomason cofibration into every fibrant target.
depends_on: D.17; the specified trivial cofibration {a}→F and boundary arrow a→b
notes: No finite length, orientation, or backtracking can extend the identity of F while moving its value at a. Both categories in the cofibration and the target are fibrant and weakly contractible.

statement: For every fibrant A, cofibration i:A→B and p with pi categorically homotopic to id_A, a strict retraction exists in the categorical homotopy class of p.
depends_on: D.17; explicit fibrant collage A; explicit trivial-cofibration pushout B; explicit functors p,q,e,r0
notes: This settles CATHOT E.6 and H4. A,B are countable posets with contractible classifying spaces; i is even a trivial cofibration. A strict retraction r0 is explicit, but every strict retraction is outside the Cat_hot class of p.

statement: Categorical comparison can fail on bifibrant sources and targets; F⊔F→F×P4 need not be a Thomason cofibration for cofibrant F.
depends_on: D.17; CpathsLurieHTT Proposition A.2.2.1
notes: The identity and constant endofunctors of F are Hot-equal and Cat_hot-unequal. A product P4 cylinder would contradict this via standard cylinder independence.
